derived_statements.statement: For fixed 0<alpha<1/4, sum_{q<=L^alpha,(q,30)=1}|A_q-M Gamma_q| <<_alpha L^(5/3+4alpha/3), uniformly in n.
derived_statements.scope: Gamma_q is an explicitly truncated joint-period density ratio, not multiplicative and not asserted to be 1/q.

derived_statements.statement: For a polynomial prime band, sum |N_p-Mg(p)| >= M sum g(p)-M^2/(a n^a), for g=1/p or 1/(p+1).
derived_statements.scope: Blocks o(M) absolute errors for these random-integer models, not signed aggregates or all sieve variants.

derived_statements.statement: For odd u=1 mod 4, F_u(s)=u^(s/2) sum_{h|u}chi4(h)h^(-s) is even entire with nonnegative Taylor coefficients, and vanishing order equals the number of odd bad-prime valuations.
derived_statements.consequence: All-failing bulk samples satisfy D_n(2/log n) >= (4/sqrt(e))D_n(1/log n).

derived_statements.statement: ML-D2 plus I2 implies representation for all sufficiently large n.
The signed minorant (4Z(s)-Z(2s))/3 is at most b(m), with the stated fourth-order error.
derived_statements.scope: No positivity of its actual-grid sum proved; tau(oddpart(m)), not tau(m).

derived_statements.statement: After a y>=n^(1/4) odd-defect cutoff, failing rows have unique two-prime completion m=pqr with b(r)=1.
derived_statements.scope: An identity, not a count saving or exceptional-set compression.
